CampusCenter furniture print variant R02

Separate derivative of the validated v25 print package and preserved furniture R01. 63 enhancement placement groups carried from pinned B05: 23 geometry reuses and 40 generic estimated representations. In addition, 37 existing Fitness source meshes are replaced from the corrected complete donor group. Source dimensions and styles remain estimates where labeled as such. Eleven photo presentations, two trophy cases and three thin wall racks are omitted.

B05 is the donor explicitly named by fitness_support_v26_r02. Its read-only proof records five shafts intersecting both supporting uprights, loaded bars removed from two standalone benches, and 6,589 other meshes unchanged. The upper furniture field is reconstructed without the old Fitness donor group before B05 is added. Support hardware/product safety is not certified.

Four large variants retain 1:87.5, 4.8 mm floors, overall dimensions within 0.003 mm and exact v25 split coordinates. Supported maximum-surface envelopes use 0.5 mm sampling plus one-cell broadening per side. The separate 1:350 assembly retains 0 / 12.192 / 23.077714 mm installation levels and the original roof grid. No intentional room-envelope edits.

The acrylic family trims added furniture within existing pane/channel insertion envelopes; original frames/panes are untouched. Nominal 1.85 mm slots, 1.5875 mm acrylic and 0.2625 mm total thickness clearance remain. Optional partitions, cut sheets and coupons retain original v25 conventions.

Digital evidence and limits

36 STLs and 37 3MFs reopened: watertight, consistent winding, no zero-area faces, explicit connected physical pieces, Z=0 and bed fit where applicable. Added acrylic insertion collisions: zero. Individual pieces fit the established 290 × 300 × 315 mm envelope; full assembly files are references, not single-bed jobs. STEP receipts report reopened B-representation bounds and volume. The saved editable file is Blender 5.0 format and must be opened in Blender 5.0 or a compatible newer version.

Untested: slicing, toolpaths, physical printer/material response, coupon/acrylic fit and assembly acceptance. There is no exhaustive medial-axis feature-thickness certification. Broadening is constructive reinforcement; floor/cut clipping can leave smaller tips, and tall/narrow masses need slicer review. No supported installed print slicer was found; no installation or printer operation occurred.
